paragraphs: Ammi. Acha bar Ammi; Achadvoya bar Ammi; Huna, Chiyya, Chanan, Yehudah, Yosef, Yaakov, Yitzchak, Natan, Rabbah, Shmuel, and Tanchum, each bar Ammi. [Glosses: Ammi. (a) Niddah 31b: Yitzchak said in Ammi’s name; immediately nearby, Yitzchak of Ammi’s school in the new editions. Shabbat 80b: Yitzchak said, “Ammi’s school said”; most places: Yitzchak of Ammi’s school. (b) Pesachim 119b: Avira expounded, sometimes in Rav’s name (the gloss proposes Rabbi Ammi) and sometimes in Rav Ashi’s (it proposes Rabbi Assi). The checked Bavli reads Rav Ammi and Rav Assi.]
